hotspots.label: Tokens
hotspots.detail: Separate tokens per environment, each with an expiry, IP restrictions to known infrastructure, and a minimum rotation period of 1440 minutes.

hotspots.label: Source access
hotspots.detail: Read-only keys where the source supports them.

hotspots.label: Logs
hotspots.detail: Query parameters are redacted in request logs. Redaction covers logging only, so keep secrets out of error messages.

hotspots.label: Teardown
hotspots.detail: teardown cannot be undone, and there is no Indexing API operation to delete a datasource registration.
